title: Choose the visual world for GlossyGemzbyZee
question: The roll assigned The Grading Certificate. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Grading Certificate
options.lineage: gem grading reports and security-printed certificates
options.thesis: Every piece arrives with its papers: the store is a set of certificates you can shop.
options.viewport: A full-width certificate: guilloche border, a plotted line drawing of the featured ring with leader-line annotations, a spec table (metal, stone, carat, size, ₦ price) and a foil seal that is the Add to bag button.
options.risk: Can read bureaucratic if the drawings are timid; the plots must be beautiful enough to sell the piece without photos.

raised.raise: Flat ink fields at full commitment: no glow, no soft gradients except the real rainbow-print guilloche.
Every drawing carries pinned leader-line annotations with tabular figures, so the spec is read on the piece itself.
One ruled certificate grid governs every page; nothing floats off it.
State is a mark, not a hue: sold out is stamped, removed bag lines are struck with undo, the paid order is embossed.

options.label: The Jeweller's Velvet Tray
options.lineage: the shop counter's velvet display trays and ring rolls
options.thesis: The catalogue is a tray of numbered velvet slots; you lift a piece out to look closer.
options.viewport: A deep plum velvet tray filling the screen, nine numbered slots, one piece lifted forward under a counter lamp.
options.risk: Familiar: dark, rich and gold is where most luxury jewellery sites land.

options.label: Woven Brocade
options.thesis: Collections woven row by row; a gold motif gathers as you scroll.
options.viewport: A midnight woven field where gold weft resolves into the featured piece's silhouette.
options.case: Strong recognition with owambe and aso-oke culture; weaker on clarity, since specs and prices fight the weave.
options.risk: Gold on midnight sits close to the luxury default.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: The bag and checkout are a coupon book: each step tears off and stamps itself.
options.viewport: Featured pieces as boarding coupons with fare boxes in ₦ and a baggage-tag Add to bag.
options.case: Very clear checkout flow; shoppers don't connect travel paper with fine jewellery.
options.risk: Reads as a travel brand if the jewellery doesn't dominate.

options.label: Starship Wall Panel
options.thesis: Shop by colour banks on a black console.
options.viewport: Elbow-framed console with categories as pill buttons.
options.case: Shoppers don't identify with it and it hides the pieces.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: Pieces shown as light moves across them.
options.viewport: A ruled section with a moving sunbeam.
options.case: Loses on both identification and clarity.

options.label: ANSI Nightboard
options.thesis: The store as a text board.
options.case: Loses on both axes for fine jewellery.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Pieces strung on a perforated rail.
options.viewport: Orange rail of frames with set-aside pieces on pins.
options.kept: State shown as marks, not colours.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean luxury jewellery store: white space, serif wordmark, big product photos.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed hero photo, collection tiles, best-sellers carousel.
canonCard.risk: Needs real product photography to work, and looks like every competitor.

outcome: Superseded: the owner pinned the direction of her first site plus her logo colours.
